name: init-plan
description: Plan-document harness: bootstrap canonical plan/ documents, author the SDD/API/SDS/SCS suite, and retrieve source-backed plan evidence via Plan RAG.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, design, and retrieve project plan documents.
interface.longDescription: Four skills plus a Plan RAG MCP server. init-design writes a project's requirements, architecture, and decisions to plan/ from an intent document; init-phases turns that design into a test-and-harness phase plan in plan/; software-doc-suite routes content into SDD, API Docs, SDS, and SCS; plan-rag searches and safely updates the plan corpus with source-backed excerpts.
defaultPrompt: Design the plan/ documents for this project from intent.md.
Write the test, harness, and phase plan from the design.
What does the plan say about phase 2?
